{{Quote|Enclosed are the topline findings of agents operating in or near the following Imperial shipyards: Corellia, Kuat, Ringo Vinda, Allanteen VI, and Fondor.|Airen Cracken, to Mon Mothma, in an official document|<ref name="Rebel Files" />}}
'''Allanteen VI''', or simply '''Allanteen''', was an astronomical object located in the [[Expansion Region]], on the [[Corellian Run]] and the [[Shipwrights' Trace]] [[hyperspace route]]s. It was the site of a [[Allanteen VI shipyards|shipyard]] that was a major producer of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[starship]]s. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] agents based around Allanteen VI reported to [[General]] [[Airen Cracken]] of the Rebel Alliance on the [[shipyard]]'s production. General [[Crix Madine]] considered the shipyard a potential target for a rebel campaign if another campaign, [[Operation Ringbreaker]], was successful.

==Description==
Allanteen VI,<ref name="Rebel Files" /> also known as just Allanteen,<ref name="Where">{{SW|url=news/where-in-the-galaxy-are-the-worlds-of-rogue-one|text=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of ''Rogue One''?|int=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Rogue One?}}</ref> was an astronomical object located in the sixth position<ref name="Rebel Files" /> of the [[Tynna sector]]'s [[Allanteen system]] within the [[Expansion Region]]<ref name="Systems" /> and [[the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> Situated in the grid square O-14 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it was located on the [[Corellian Run]]<ref name="Galaxy" /> [[super-hyperroute]]<ref name="BMF 48">{{BuildFalconCite|48|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> between the [[Rhommamool system|Rhommamool]] and [[Gamor system]]s,<ref name="TFABG">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> and also on the [[hyperspace route]] known as the [[Shipwrights' Trace]],<ref name="Shipwrights" /> which connected it to the [[Tynna system]] and ultimately the [[Foless system]].<ref name="Galaxy" />

==History==
{{Quote|With Operation Ringbreaker meeting with early success, I feel our current angle of attack could provide a broader path to victory. This map notates the locations of other major Imperial shipyards and drydocks, as well as key mining centers for metals and ores. Once we take out Kuat, these should be our next targets.|Crix Madine, to Mon Mothma, in an official document|<ref name="Rebel Files" />}}
[[File:Allanteen-TRF.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Allanteen VI was the site of a major Imperial shipyard.]]
During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Allanteen VI was the site of a [[Allanteen VI shipyards|shipyard]] that became a major production source of Imperial [[starship]]s. [[General]] [[Airen Cracken]] of the then-unofficial [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion's]] [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|Intelligence branch]] had a number of agents operating around Allanteen and other Imperial [[shipyard]] hubs including [[Corellia]], [[Fondor]], [[Kuat]], and [[Ringo Vinda]]. Through those agents, he gathered information on the [[Imperial Navy]]'s [[Star Destroyer]]s and patrol vessels and detailed them in an official document addressed to the Rebellion's leader, [[Mon Mothma]], that cited Allanteen VI as part of the investigations.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="3 ABY">{{BTCdate}}</ref> the since-[[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|officialized]] Rebel Alliance's [[61st Mobile Infantry]] led a campaign named [[Operation Ringbreaker]] against a number of minor Imperial resource hubs, with the [[Kuat Drive Yards]], the Empire's primary source of Star Destroyer production and servicing, being the final target.<ref name="BTC">''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]''</ref> The Alliance Intelligence vetted the campaign from afar, and General [[Crix Madine]], inspired by its early success, made a [[The galaxy|galactic]] [[Star map|map]] of major Imperial shipyards, drydocks, and [[mining]] centers that could be targeted if Kuat Drive Yards was successfully sabotaged, attaching it to another official document sent to Mothma. Allanteen VI was included on the map, labeled as having a low production rate and security level. Operation Ringbreaker, however, was ultimately cut short. [[Archivist]] [[Hendri Underholt]] eventually added both documents mentioning Allanteen VI to a compilation of non-electronic documents called ''[[The Rebel Files]]''.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="MandoVGDate">{{MandoVGDate}}</ref> Allanteen VI fell within the borders of the [[New Republic]].<ref name="MandoVG" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Starcruiserdate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser|''Star Wars'': Galactic Starcruiser]] to [[34 ABY]].</ref> Allanteen's position was displayed in a partial [[map]] of the [[galaxy]] on several [[Viewscreen|screens]] aboard [[Chandrila Star Line]]'s [[MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser|Star Cruiser]] ''[[Halcyon]]''.<ref name="GS">[[Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser|''Star Wars'': Galactic Starcruiser]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BTMF52.png|thumb|right|200px|Allanteen VI was first introduced via mention on a map in ''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 52 in the current canon.]]
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Allanteen VI was first mentioned on a map included in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 52|fifty-second issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s magazine series ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'',<ref name="BMF 52">{{BuildFalconCite|52|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> published around [[December 30]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BuildFalconDates|52}}</ref> The map only used the shorter designation "Allanteen,"<ref name="BMF 52" /> which was first described as a celestial body in "[[Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Rogue One?]]," a [[StarWars.com]] article written by [[Mark Newbold]] and published on [[January 31]] [[2017]].<ref name="Where" /> The celestial body was then given its full name in the reference book and boxed set ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="Rebel Files" /> and released on [[November 21]] of that same year.<ref name="November 21">{{Twitter|danwall88|status/931228678553591808|[[Daniel Wallace]]|quote=Just heard 11/21 revised on sale. Active Amazon link soon I hope. Keeping an eye on it.}}</ref> Its first [[in-universe]] appearance came in the form of a map depiction viewable in [[Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser|''Star Wars'': Galactic Starcruiser]], an immersive roleplaying experience at [[W:c:disney:Walt Disney World Resort|Walt Disney World Resort]] in Florida<ref name="GS" /> that was opened to the public on [[March 1]], [[2022]],<ref name="31 Things">{{SW|url=news/31-things-we-learned-about-star-wars-galactic-starcruiser|text=31 Things We Learned in an Exclusive Preview of ''Star Wars'': Galactic Starcruiser|nolive=1}}</ref> and had its final voyage from [[September 28]] to [[September 30|30]], [[2023]].<ref name="StarcruiserClosure">{{Disney|subdomain=disneyworld|domain=go.com|url=destinations/star-wars-galactic-starcruiser|text=''Star Wars'': Galactic Starcruiser}}</ref>

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Allanteen VI/Legends|Allanteen VI]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a tie-in novel for the [[2008]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. ''Wild Space'' was written by [[Karen Miller]]<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref> and was published on [[December 9]] that same year.<ref name="Penguin-Paperback">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/114726/wild-space-star-wars-legends-the-clone-wars-by-karen-miller|text=Wild Space: Star Wars Legends (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>
